description: The Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN) of Argentina publishes its national reference geographic information as downloadable GIS layers (Capas SIG), organised by the national catalogue of geographic objects. Contents: about 188 layers, among them the national, provincial and tertiary road networks (vial nacional, vial provincial, vial terciaria), rail lines and stations, air transport lines and points, ports and piers, crossings and links such as bridges, transport infrastructure, electricity transmission lines, power plants (central eléctrica), transformer stations, ducts, valve chambers, fuel tanks, hydrocarbon wells and fields, drinking water treatment plants, water pumping plants, elevated water tanks, sewage and waste treatment plants, landfills, dams and weirs, telecommunication towers and antennas, alongside hydrography, settlements, health and education facilities, boundaries and hazard layers shared by partner agencies (INPRES seismic zones, SEGEMAR landslides and volcanoes, SINAGIR hazards). Coverage: continental and bicontinental Argentina, at the 1:250,000 reference scale of the SIG 250 base. Format and access: per-layer downloads, mostly Shapefile with some GeoPackage, each with a PDF metadata sheet; the same layers are served by the IGN GeoServer (WMS and WFS) and ready-made base map projects for ArcGIS and QGIS are offered. Free; licence not stated on the pages read, a use instructions and licence PDF accompanies the base map projects. Caveats: attributes and update dates differ by layer, and several thematic layers come from other agencies. Simulation uses: national road, rail and utility networks for hazard exposure and network flow models of Argentina. Related records: the IG-GIRD disaster risk portal of IGN (data-ign-argentina-ig-gird-disaster-risk).
